note: Hand-written inputs for scripts/progress-data.mjs. Releases: summary and figures the release reports lack. Timeline: curated entries in CEST; covers names generated events (release:<world>@<v>, ipc:<v>, world:<v>) an entry already describes.

days.2026-10-10: compressed release, feel, a second test machine

lumen-reach@0.4.0.summary: First release: Sun Court, Array Hall, Rime Vault and Signal Rise, 24 mounts, routes and alternate stairs

lumen-reach@0.5.0.summary: Visual polish in every home; about 60 frames/s per home at Medium on an Intel iGPU at 4K

lumen-reach@0.6.0.summary: Rime Vault frost and density pass

lumen-reach@0.6.1.summary: Moves to world format 0.5: authored visibility regions for every home

lumen-reach@0.7.0.summary: Closed sky dome and mountain basin; flight passes over the perimeter; 56-view any-angle sweep and full route traversal

lumen-reach@0.7.1.summary: Fixes from the first live walk: sky seam, a capped stair, the night sky

lumen-reach@0.8.0.summary: First release on world format 0.7: KTX2 textures, meshopt geometry and lightmap mips; same look and frame time

lumen-reach@0.8.1.summary: Closes a Rime Vault ceiling slot that showed sky; the build now fails on sky leaks through enclosure roofs and walls

lumen-reach@0.9.0.summary: Visibility derived at build time (184 visibility areas); per-area playable volumes with a 60 m fly ceiling; backstops only where a walker can reach; canonical areas contract

lumen-reach@0.9.1.summary: Fixes from live testing: the four primary walls are true 16:9 frames, signs clear the roofs, rails on the rooftop walkway, bridge and raised landings, a terrain shading fix

switchyard@0.1.1.summary: The public test world: vault concourse, timber docks and station rings

lumen-reach@0.9.2.summary: The same world as 0.9.1, rebuilt so its shipped images carry no build metadata; all checks pass with unchanged budgets

switchyard@0.1.2.summary: The same test world as 0.1.1, rebuilt from cleaned sources with neutral attribution text

hyprune-starter@0.1.1.summary: Residents' textures stay GPU-compressed (UASTC base colour and normals): 16 MiB instead of 64 MiB for all four, closer to the lossless originals

lumen-reach@0.11.0.summary: Residents: one per area on authored routes with stops, benches and short lines; Crimson marks the way to Rime Vault and Ember guides you to Signal Rise

hyprune-starter@0.2.0.summary: Three gauges (tube, abacus, voxel cube) fed by scripts, with a running-average ring and gold, orange and red states

lumen-reach@0.11.1.summary: Fixes from live testing: no more flickering tiles, decks and beams where surfaces met flush, no drain pipe stubs on the roof, the valley below the edges in daylight instead of black, and residents stop in front of the screens

lumen-reach@0.11.2.summary: The valley: the painted panorama continues into the terrain below the settlement, with no horizon seam; rock cliffs under the plinths.

timeline.title: Schemas, RFCs and this site
timeline.text: IPC 0.1 and world format 0.1 with a validator; RFC-0001 to 0008; the organisation profile and the first version of hyprune.com.

timeline.title: Core M0: a safe place
timeline.text: Exact-version Hyprland plugin, the hypruned daemon, a GLES renderer, an original room, free flight, the emergency exit and a guarded nested test harness.

timeline.title: SDK 0.1
timeline.text: A typed IPC client, a mock daemon and the hyprune CLI to validate, pack and scaffold.

timeline.title: Switchyard test world
timeline.text: A six-dock transit world with a PBR trim library and a vaulted terminal.

timeline.title: The shell begins
timeline.text: A validated IPC bridge, the Director, the HUD and warp transitions between places.

timeline.title: Materials and navigation
timeline.text: IPC 0.2 and world format 0.2: camera, waypoints, travel and autodrive; PBR materials and UV1 lightmaps.

timeline.title: First real session
timeline.text: Core, the Quickshell shell and Switchyard together over authenticated IPC 0.3.

timeline.title: Workspace homes
timeline.text: IPC 0.4 and world format 0.3: areas, typed mounts and placement volumes; alpha sorting, bloom and reflections.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach is built
timeline.text: Sun Court, Array Hall, Rime Vault and Signal Rise, each a workspace home, connected into one settlement.

timeline.title: Hands-on interaction
timeline.text: IPC 0.5: tools, carrying windows and custom placement, with desktop handovers deferred out of the render pass.

timeline.title: Keymap v2
timeline.text: IPC 0.6 and the input schema: up to three bindings per action, live reload, crouch, and Settings in the shell.

timeline.title: Starter kits and installers
timeline.text: Nix flake, NixOS and Home Manager modules, three kits and an Arch installer.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.4.0 and Switchyard 0.1.1
timeline.text: The first official world packages.

timeline.title: Supervised live testing begins
timeline.text: Swap-in and panic tooling for real sessions, and the first fixes from them: window adoption and native desktop interaction.

timeline.title: Live rounds two and three
timeline.text: Carry orientation, capture timing, overlays rendered in core, bounded 4K frame work, and dynamic render scale: the change behind 60 FPS at 4K on the iGPU.

timeline.title: Graphics presets
timeline.text: IPC 0.7 and IPC 0.8: Low/Medium/High/Ultra and auto with GPU timings, hold timing, and a responsive Director with a curved HUD.

timeline.title: Render and protocol hardening
timeline.text: BVH raycasts, budgeted uploads, capabilities inherited by numeric version, and a dedicated world workspace.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.5.0
timeline.text: Visual polish in every home.

timeline.title: RFC-0009 proposed
timeline.text: Optional supervised GPU offload.

timeline.title: HUD concepts and the Performance page
timeline.text: IPC 0.9 and IPC 0.10: opt-in HUD telemetry, three curved HUD concepts and live Performance controls.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.6.0
timeline.text: Rime Vault frost and density pass.

timeline.title: Climbing contracts and offload phase 1
timeline.text: IPC 0.11 and world format 0.4: climbable volumes. A supervised offload worker with local fallback is merged, off by default; shader warm-up and a program-binary cache.

timeline.title: Recording, replay and free cursor
timeline.text: IPC 0.12: deterministic input and camera recordings; climbing merged; Super+Tab or Back for a real cursor.

timeline.title: HUD legibility
timeline.text: Solid text and contrast that holds on bright worlds.

timeline.title: Ink, visibility and the photo camera
timeline.text: IPC 0.13, IPC 0.14 and world format 0.5: authored outline style with quality tiers, visibility regions and an authoring photo camera.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.6.1
timeline.text: The first release on world format 0.5.

timeline.title: Tool slots and the pocket
timeline.text: IPC 0.15: shared Primary/Secondary/Alternate/Cycle bindings and the Placement tool's pocket queue.

timeline.title: Recovery from live testing
timeline.text: A multi-world launcher; the shell survives invalid frames and renews its credentials without dropping the session.

timeline.title: Playable bounds
timeline.text: world format 0.6: where the camera may fly.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.7.0
timeline.text: Closed sky dome, any-angle checks and full route traversal.

timeline.title: World-derived workspace homes
timeline.text: The world room is workspace 20 and each area's home is 20 + its slot.

timeline.title: Render on demand and FSR 1
timeline.text: Static scenes stop rendering (compositor GPU 42% to 1%), memory and CPU work, and FSR 1 as the default upscaler.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.7.1
timeline.text: Fixes from the first live walk of 0.7.0.

timeline.title: Compressed assets
timeline.text: world format 0.7: KTX2 textures, meshopt compression and quantised meshes.

timeline.title: A refreshed site
timeline.text: The version-aware schema reference, a progress page and RFC-0001 to 0009 accepted.

timeline.title: A new identity
timeline.text: The Hyprune logo and app icon across the site and shell, and an optional watermark for saved captures.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.7.2
timeline.text: A walkable, clear roof route.

timeline.title: Upscaler choice and shader work
timeline.text: IPC 0.16: FSR 1 or bilinear. Shaders compile in parallel with the upload (51 to 31 ms) and the world shader is specialised per preset (21% faster on Intel Low).

timeline.title: Derived visibility
timeline.text: Visibility regions generated from the navmesh and scene instead of written by hand.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.8.0
timeline.text: The first release on world format 0.7: 41% smaller, 45% less GPU memory, same frame time.

timeline.title: Autodrive on stairs, idle fix, stacking order
timeline.text: Autodrive walks routes like the player; walls recompose only when their windows change (idle GPU 2% to 0.07%) and follow Hyprland's stacking order.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.8.1
timeline.text: A Rime Vault ceiling slot no longer shows sky.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.9.0
timeline.text: Derived visibility at build time, per-area playable volumes, walking-only backstops and canonical areas.

timeline.title: Shared version helpers
timeline.text: Schema, SDK and shell derive their protocol lists from the schema directories instead of hand-kept lists.

timeline.title: Capture notes
timeline.text: IPC 0.17: after U, the shell asks why and saves the note with the capture.

timeline.title: Fixes from the 0.9.0 live walk
timeline.text: World geometry is static to gestures, windows can be carried from behind, empty walls show the wallpaper or a placeholder, and placed windows snap into tool mounts.

timeline.title: Frame pacing and wall clarity
timeline.text: Ticks follow presented frames with their real time, targets pace evenly, and walls render at native resolution.

timeline.title: A second test machine
timeline.text: A headless two-GPU machine runs isolated nested sessions. It found and fixed a render-pass tracking leak, a daemon start-up race and misattributed GL errors.

timeline.title: Offload on NVIDIA
timeline.text: Offload works when the compositor runs on NVIDIA, same-GPU or cross-GPU; IPC 0.18 picks the offload GPU and scales the power cap to it.

timeline.title: Grab stall fixed
timeline.text: Starting a carry from behind: 239 ms to 0.16 ms.

timeline.title: Player settings and the reticle
timeline.text: IPC 0.19: field of view, walk and run speed, reach limits, view bob and a contextual reticle in six styles.

timeline.title: Nightly regression
timeline.text: Every automatable suite, the schema, SDK and shell tests and the world builds run each night on the second machine.

timeline.title: Room windows at their docks
timeline.text: Windows that exist when a world loads take their authored docks instead of waiting in the pocket.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.9.1
timeline.text: Fixes from live testing: 16:9 primary walls, signs clear of roofs, rooftop rails and a shading fix.

timeline.title: Black-pixel shader fix
timeline.text: Guards against invalid values in the world shader: at a tester's pose, black pixels dropped from 7,800 to 5. Found by replaying the tester's capture pose.

timeline.title: Second nightly round
timeline.text: Stale test harnesses brought current and an unreachable roll gesture removed.

timeline.title: Clean rebuilds, then the repositories go public
timeline.text: Switchyard 0.1.2 and Lumen Reach 0.9.2 are rebuilt from cleaned sources. The same day every Hyprune repository becomes public on GitHub.

timeline.title: Blueprint maps and pocket actions
timeline.text: IPC 0.20: per-level blueprint maps generated from each world's geometry, and putting windows in the pocket and taking them out from the Director.

timeline.title: Machines prototype
timeline.text: Placed objects driven by data: five deterministic simulators (CI, queue, server rack, deploy, build) move jobs through machines in the world.

timeline.title: Gizmo 2.0
timeline.text: The position tool (tool 4) gets move, rotate and scale handles in perspective, drawn anti-aliased at native resolution, with placement rules, previews and undo.

timeline.title: Quests and markers
timeline.text: IPC 0.21: tapping TAB shows waypoints and markers for a moment, holding it opens the Director. hypruned runs personal quests and focus sessions.

timeline.title: Object catalog
timeline.text: IPC 0.22: installed libraries form an object catalog. Objects come out of the pocket with tool 5 and are saved as user placements.

timeline.title: No catalog hitches; objects in offload
timeline.text: A watch that rescanned the catalog every 1.2 s and costly aiming caused stalls: on the catalog demo at 1080p60, frame gaps over 25 ms fell from 177 to 13–28 and p99 from 114.6 to 21–23 ms. The offload worker now draws world objects.

timeline.title: Only the room floats
timeline.text: Windows on a home's wall stay tiled when you leave focus; a window moved into the world goes to the room.

timeline.title: Path tool
timeline.text: Tool 3 picks path points under the reticle: drag, insert, delete and undo. Paths are drawn only while the tool is out.

timeline.title: Core 0.4.0: prebuilt core
timeline.text: Each core tag now publishes a build for Hyprland 0.56.2 with its ABI hash. Try it uses it when your Hyprland matches, so there is nothing to compile.

timeline.title: Residents
timeline.text: World format 0.9 and IPC 0.23: characters walk authored paths, stop, sit on seats, step aside and guide you. The offload worker draws them too. Core 0.5.0 ships it.

timeline.title: Gauges
timeline.text: A tube that fills with liquid, an abacus of 100 beads and a cube of 100 voxels show any value from 0 to 100. A script feeds each one its value, display text and label; core keeps a running average, shown as a white ring. A placed machine reads the data source named after it, with no bindings file.

timeline.title: Data sources in the Director
timeline.text: IPC 0.24: Objects → Placed shows a gauge's inputs with live values and edits its command and interval, with Test, Save and Restart, and no world reload.

timeline.title: Machines in offload
timeline.text: The offload worker draws machine state (fills, beads, labels), so a placed gauge no longer forces local rendering.

timeline.title: Wrapped captions, hidden residents
timeline.text: Say lines wrap over up to four lines. A resident hidden behind a wall is neither drawn nor keeps frames coming; at rest in Rime Vault the frame rate drops to 0.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.11.0
timeline.text: Residents in the world: one per area on its own route, with a vista, a stop by a screen and a bench where it sits. Crimson marks the way to Rime Vault and Ember walks you to Signal Rise.

timeline.title: Core 0.6.0
timeline.text: Data sources, gauges, machines in offload, wrapped captions, hidden residents at no cost and GPU-compressed character textures, with a prebuilt for Hyprland 0.56.2 that Try it installs.

timeline.title: Companions
timeline.text: IPC 0.25: pick a companion character from an installed library and it follows you through any world, catches up after a warp, keeps out of the way of your screens and talks when you press E. Put it, or any character you placed, on a drawn path by binding it with the path tool or carrying it there. Core 0.7.0.

timeline.title: Registry, phase 1
timeline.text: RFC-0015: official, community and labelled custom sources; install, update, roll back, pin and remove with every download checked against its hash, from the SDK's command line and the Director's Library page. The installers preinstall the pinned libraries.

timeline.title: Smooth demo cameras
timeline.text: Demo recordings use a camera driven by core: keyframed tracks on smooth curves and follow shots, written out through a frame export path that records every presented frame. Demo films no longer stutter the way screen captures did.

timeline.title: Characters move whenever the world is shown
timeline.text: Residents and the companion no longer pause on battery, when you stop moving, while you type or in the free cursor; they pause only while the world is inactive or covered. Motion still, off and reduced motion are how you stop them, and a request they can't carry out is refused with the reason. Render on demand and the hidden-resident test keep the cost to characters in view.

timeline.title: Live offload pacing
timeline.text: With offload on, the worker hands the compositor one fresh frame per frame in a live session; at 60 Hz a quarter of frames used to repeat. Frame pacing now matches rendering in the compositor.

timeline.title: Ghost windows fixed
timeline.text: Every window on the room and home workspaces gets a record. Past the old cap of 16 records, new windows opened invisible and could not be pocketed. A closed window is now dropped at once, also while another is in focus.

timeline.title: Steering, avoidance and gait
timeline.text: RFC-0010 amendment: characters steer round each other, take detours round placed objects and pillars, and stop in front of a screen just outside its approach zone. Their feet keep in step with their speed, without sliding. The companion eases its pace and can walk or run with you.

timeline.title: Core 0.7.2
timeline.text: No-cap window records, characters that move whenever the world is shown, steering and gait, demo cameras, live offload pacing and a demo source for newly placed machines, with a prebuilt for Hyprland 0.56.2 that Try it installs.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.11.1
timeline.text: Fixes from live testing. Surfaces that met flush (tiles, decks, beams, screen frames) no longer flicker: the build removes hidden faces and steps the rest back, and a new check covers every plane in the world. The valley floor below the settlement edges is in daylight instead of reading as black glass, and residents stop in front of the screens they look at.

timeline.title: Debug tool on the wire
timeline.text: IPC 0.26: shells see the debug tool (key 9) and its layer, legend and info card; the companion's walk or run pace is part of its state and can be set from Settings → Companion; the Director lists every pocketed window, up to 128.

timeline.title: Core 0.8.0
timeline.text: IPC 0.26 in a release: the debug tool, the companion's pace and the whole pocket list, with a prebuilt for Hyprland 0.56.2 that Try it installs. SDK 0.10.0 and schema 0.12.0 carry the same contract.

timeline.title: Core 0.8.1
timeline.text: Fixes from the Lumen Reach 0.11.1 live notes and the queue: offload draws the companion and anything from a library installed mid-session; the waypoint line lies on the ground and its route goes round hills and buildings (RFC-0004 amendment); arriving clears the waypoint (RFC-0012 amendment); marker labels at 4K; characters use their own names; Recall spreads windows out. No wire change; Try it installs the new prebuilt.

timeline.title: Lumen Reach 0.11.2
timeline.text: The valley below the settlement was plain grey rock under a hard edge across the painted horizon. Now the terrain carries the panorama itself: from the Sun Court and the Array Hall its forests, cliffs, waterfalls and cloud sea run on below the edges, and the rim shows the painting it covers, so the seam is gone. The slopes and cliff under the plinths stay rock. Same frame times as 0.11.1.

timeline.title: Core 0.8.2
timeline.text: Fixes: a GPU that enforces less than 20 W no longer trips the offload power cap; new characters upload over several frames, so spawning a few no longer hitches; the reticle hint and route checks use the collision index; characters from older exporters (specular-glossiness materials) keep their colours; X11 menus stay with their own app instead of the focused window. No wire change; Try it installs the new prebuilt.

timeline.title: Core 0.8.3
timeline.text: Fixes: after a screen lock or the display turning off, the HUD comes back (the shell could not take its screen again); spawning a character in front of you finds open floor past the areas reserved for windows, and a refusal says why; the E USE / F FOCUS prompt hides while you use a window. No wire change; Try it installs the new prebuilt.

timeline.title: Core 0.8.4
timeline.text: Fixes: a character you placed can be set down on a path you drew with tool 3 (or rebound to it from Director → Objects), which then becomes its route; your companion no longer stands idle far away when you stop where there is no free spot near you (the foot of the Signal Rise ramp); with offload, steam behind a character no longer draws over them. No wire change; Try it installs the new prebuilt.

timeline.title: Workspace screens
timeline.text: IPC 0.27 (draft) and object format 0.11: place a screen anywhere, 16:9 or 21:9, on a wall or on a stand, and it shows a workspace live like a home wall, on the next free workspace or the one you choose. Windows there stay tiled, F flies in and selecting the workspace travels to the screen.

timeline.title: Import a model from the Director
timeline.text: Objects → Import… turns a glTF, GLB, OBJ or FBX file into an object without Blender: it guesses the units and shows the size to confirm, turns Z-up models upright, simplifies to a triangle target, shrinks and compresses textures, builds a collision shape and a thumbnail, and records the licence, author and source you give it (or none). Big models import with warnings instead of refusals.
